chunks: And Isma'il ibn Jabir narrated, saying:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “Is it permissible for a man to take zakat while he is not in need of it, and then give it in charity?” He said: “Yes.”
And he said the like of that regarding the fitrah.

key_terms.الزَّكَاةَ: zakat, the obligatory alms being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.الْفِطْرَةِ: zakat al-fitrah, the charity associated with the end of Ramadan
key_terms.فَيَتَصَدَّقَ: then to give it as charity

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to receive zakat without needing it and then give it in charity?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that it is permissible for a person who is not personally in need to take zakat and then give it away in charity. The same ruling is stated to apply to zakat al-fitrah, indicating permissibility in this form of transfer and redistribution.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
I said to Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) "Is it permissible for a man to take Zakat even though he does not need it, and then give it in charity?"
Imam (as) replied: "Yes."
Imam (as) also said the same regarding the Fitrah.
